summary.text: Matt Roby is a Republican state representative from South Dakota House District 5 who assumed office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney, he was born in Watertown, South Dakota.

paragraphs.text: Matt Roby was born in Watertown, South Dakota.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln and a law degree from the University of St. Thomas, and his career experience includes working as an attorney.
Roby assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 14, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session he is assigned to the House Judiciary Committee and the House Local Government Committee.
